candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Multiple text errors: 「どくらい」 (dropped れ from どれくらい), 「122号」 instead of 22号, spurious extra 『 before 大阪大学. Table header mislabels the D group as 「D 職業」 and omits that C spans both 家事・育児 and 職業; the markdown table is malformed (column labels placed in the separator row, so it won't render). All furigana omitted. Questions arbitrarily promoted to ## headers.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Body text and all numbers correct. Attempts to preserve the two-tier A/B/C/D header structure, though cell alignment in the group-label rows is imperfect (家事・育児/職業/総労働時間 spans don't line up). Furigana partially captured (たなかしげと, ばっすい) but けんきゅうか, ねんぼう, さ omitted. Answer table for (3) puts 日本 in the header row, a minor structural flaw.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All numbers and text correct; sensible flattening of the multi-row header into combined column labels (A 家事・育児 女性 etc.) that preserves meaning unambiguously. Most furigana captured (たなかしげと, けんきゅうか, ばっすい), though ねんぽう vs image's ねんぼう is a tiny discrepancy and さ (for 差) omitted. Answer table for (3) uses 日本 as header row, minor issue.

rationale: C is the most accurate: every number and character matches, the flattened table headers are unambiguous and faithful, and it captures the most furigana with no inventions (only a trivial ねんぽう/ねんぼう rendaku discrepancy). B is close behind — text and data are equally correct — but its group-header rows are misaligned and it captures less furigana. A ranks last due to substantive character errors (どくらい, 122号 instead of 22号, extra 『), a mislabeled/incorrect header structure (calling D 「職業」), a broken markdown table separator, and complete omission of furigana.
